selection_policy.current_sampling: seeded hash order; balanced bridge/comparison; require an unused similar match; no performance filtering
selection_policy.similar_rule: same type, question_form and level; highest question TF-IDF cosine among unused tasks
selection_policy.regression_rule: different type AND question_form; same level; seeded hash order among unused tasks
selection_policy.tfidf: NFKC casefold word tokens; fixed stopwords; (1+ln(tf))*(1+ln((N+1)/(df+1))); L2 cosine
selection_policy.deduplication: global ID and normalized question text

source_integrity.rule: valid official row structure and supporting-fact references within supplied context; no answer-content or performance filtering
